reviews.title: I Don’t Get It
reviews.text: Paid for this app at the suggestion of another musician.   I wanted to use it for the drum loops.  For rock or pop stuff, for many of the drum tracks, there is no variation at all…they are identical;  just with a different name.  I’ve not found this app useful or easily comprehensible.

reviews.title: The big problem
reviews.text: I love the app, but the separate purchase for Mac and iPhone is very disappointing. It’s unacceptable that I have to pay twice just to use the same app.

reviews.title: Loop
reviews.text: Great in many ways but the looping is completely broken and for an app this expensive that’s ridiculous. May as well just use YouTube backing tracks.

reviews.title: Dommage
reviews.text: Super app, mais si on veut l’avoir sur le Mac il faut payer une deuxième fois. C’est stupide et donc je met 1 seule étoile. Soyez intelligents svp.
